load_tiktoken_model: load a tiktoken BPE model from a file path with special tokens and split regex
create_tiktoken_encoder: create a TiktokenEncoder to encode text into token index tensors with prefix and suffix tokens
encode_text_with_tiktoken: encode a string into a torch tensor of token indices using a TiktokenEncoder
create_tiktoken_decoder: create a TiktokenDecoder to decode token index tensors back into text with optional special token skipping
decode_tokens_with_tiktoken: decode a tensor of token indices or a list of token strings back into text using TiktokenDecoder
